search_evidence.name: search_evidence
search_evidence.description: Search portfolio evidence items (case studies, repos, past proposals) matching a technical requirement. Returns items with type, source, date, skills and outcome.

get_case_study.name: get_case_study
get_case_study.description: Retrieve the complete text and outcome metrics for a specific portfolio case study by ID.

list_skills.name: list_skills
list_skills.description: List all verified skills present across the freelancer's portfolio.

search_jobs.name: search_jobs
search_jobs.description: Search active freelance jobs on the marketplace by keywords. Annotations: readOnlyHint=True, idempotentHint=True.

get_job.name: get_job
get_job.description: Fetch complete specifications and client metadata for a job by job ID. Annotations: readOnlyHint=True, idempotentHint=True.

get_client_history.name: get_client_history
get_client_history.description: Retrieve client hiring track record, total spend, rating and verification status. Annotations: readOnlyHint=True, idempotentHint=True.

get_connects_balance.name: get_connects_balance
get_connects_balance.description: Get current available Connects balance and transaction history. Annotations: readOnlyHint=True, idempotentHint=True.

list_messages.name: list_messages
list_messages.description: List client messages and threads. Annotations: readOnlyHint=True, idempotentHint=True.

create_proposal_draft.name: create_proposal_draft
create_proposal_draft.description: Create a draft proposal on the marketplace. Supports dry_run=True to preview spend and payload without modifying state. Annotations: readOnlyHint=False, destructiveHint=False, idempotentHint=True.

submit_proposal.name: submit_proposal
submit_proposal.description: Submit an approved proposal to the marketplace. Spends Connects. Requires a unique idempotency_key to prevent duplicate submissions or duplicate charges. Annotations: readOnlyHint=False, destructiveHint=True, idempotentHint=True.

send_message.name: send_message
send_message.description: Send a message or proposed interview slots to a client. Requires idempotency_key. Annotations: readOnlyHint=False, destructiveHint=True, idempotentHint=True.

get_free_calendar_slots.name: get_free_calendar_slots
get_free_calendar_slots.description: Check freelancer calendar availability and return a list of free interview slots in ISO 8601 format.

create_tentative_interview_hold.name: create_tentative_interview_hold
create_tentative_interview_hold.description: Create a tentative calendar hold for a prospective client interview.

create_email_draft.name: create_email_draft
create_email_draft.description: Create a draft email in the freelancer's workspace inbox for manual review.
